controles.affirmation: En fevrier 2026 la Cour supreme a juge que l'IEEPA n'autorisait pas l'imposition de droits de douane ; Emerson a encaisse 82 M$ de remboursements (0,11 $/action) en cout des ventes, aucun benefice reconnu pour d'eventuels remboursements supplementaires
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q 2026-08-04 : "In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (\"IEEPA\") does not authorize the imposition of tariffs... During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Company filed certain claims and received tariff refunds of $82 ($0.11 per share), and the benefit was recorded in Cost of sales... The timing and amount of any further tariff refunds remain uncertain, and, accordingly, no benefit was recognized as of June 30, 2026"
